A Palestinian halal restaurant whose food is worth trying.
Sep 2026 • Family
Our experience at Oliva Palestinian Halal Food was absolutely wonderful 🤍🇵🇸

We ordered the Kabsa and it was absolutely delicious. The rice was wonderfully flavorful and perfectly seasoned, and it came with a lovely, tasty chicken thigh. Most importantly, it had no unpleasant odor whatsoever. 👌🏻

We also ordered the meat casserole and it was absolutely delicious. The meat was tender and tasted excellent. I highly recommend you try it! 😍🥘
We also ordered fries, and they were sweet and went well with the meal.

Because I liked the food so much, the rice ran out and I asked for extra rice 😂 This in itself is proof that I really liked the food!

I'd like to thank the restaurant owner for his excellent service, hospitality, and wonderful manners. He's a very respectful and helpful person, and deserves all the praise ❤️

A Palestinian halal restaurant and their food is worth trying, especially the Kabsa and meat casserole.
I highly recommend it, and God willing, we'll visit again 🤍🇵🇸

A Detestable Meal and Cold Welcome
May 2026 • Couples
We're a gay couple and visited Oliva with considerable anticipation, drawn by its promise of authentic Levantine cuisine. Regrettably, the evening proved disappointing on both gastronomic and personal levels.

Particularly striking was the so-called Palestinian salad and falafel, which were unconvincing imitations of the original Israeli dishes, missing the brightness, balance, and technical finesse that define these classics.

More troubling, however, was the atmosphere. As a married gay couple, we are accustomed to traveling widely and dining in establishments across diverse cultures. Rarely have we encountered a setting in which we felt so subtly unwelcome. While no overt hostility was expressed, the demeanor of the staff conveyed a palpable reserve. Service was distant, inattentive, and noticeably less warm than one would expect in a restaurant that aspires to international standards of hospitality.

For travelers seeking authentic Middle Eastern cuisine served with professionalism, warmth, and inclusivity, there are undoubtedly better choices in Hanoi.
